initial_prompt: Write me a short poem about the moment just before rain begins.

messages.content: Write me a short poem about the moment just before rain begins.

# Threshold

The air holds its breath—
that peculiar green light
pooling in the leaves,
and somewhere a bird
falls silent mid-phrase.

Everything leans forward.
The dust remembers
what it is about to become.

A single drop,
not yet fallen,
gathers the whole sky
into its becoming.
